t: The Bristan Wall Mount 10 shower kit is a fast-fit bar valve fixing kit designed to secure exposed bar shower valves rigidly to 15mm pipework. Ideal for professional plumbers and bathroom installers, this kit simplifies the installation, maintenance, and replacement of bar showers. Constructed from durable brass with a sleek chrome-plated finish, the kit features 15mm compression inlet connections and 3/4" BSP outlet connections to ensure a secure, leak-free fit. The package includes wall mounts, screws, rawl plugs, and clear fitting instructions for a straightforward setup on any tiling project.
